tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Get complete schema.org entity data by URL (its @id), including relationships the graph holds in either direction.

tools.name: query_relationships
tools.description: Find entities connected to a subject: one row per property value, with object_type 'uri' for links to other entities and 'literal' for values. Optionally filter by predicate.

tools.name: find_by_type
tools.description: Find all entities of a specific schema.org type (exact type name, for example Service, Person, DefinedTerm).

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Substring search across the text of every entity; returns up to 20 entity URLs.

tools.name: fuzzy_find_and_traverse
tools.description: Find and rank schema.org entities from natural language, tolerating typos and alternative names. Returns bounded entity context with relationship IDs; use get_entity for full detail. The optional detail argument is summary (for each hit: id, type, name, url, the start of the description and the matc

tools.name: traverse_path
tools.description: Walk the knowledge graph from one entity in a single call. start: an entity @id or a name (resolved like fuzzy_find_and_traverse). path: one entry per hop, each a predicate or a list of predicates; prefix a predicate with ^ to follow it backwards (e.g. ^worksFor finds who works for an organisation).

tools.name: get_citable_passages
tools.description: Return passages of the VISEON articles word for word, each with a link to the passage itself, the article it is part of and how much of the query it holds, so an answer can quote and cite them. query: the distinctive words asked about (a name, a term, a phrase the article uses). article: optional, a

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "traverse_path" is 937 chars, far longer than this server's median (174). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
